scientific.integrity: The proof is analytic. The universal lower bound uses disjoint support escape; the sharp upper bounds use Clarkson inequalities or a unit vector supported on a single atom; the atomless lower extremizer is an explicit half-mass sign split. No finite computation or failed search is used as proof of the theorem or of novelty.
limitations: Only complete sigma-finite measure spaces and \(1\le p<\infty\) are covered.
Finite-dimensional \(L_p\)-spaces, non-sigma-finite measure spaces, and \(L_\infty\) are not classified.
Originality is supported by focused semantic searches and inspection of the most relevant public primary texts, not by an exhaustive theorem database.

title: Exact local-octahedrality index of infinite-dimensional \(L_p\) spaces
